_note: V7-M PLAYER-AID CARD (CD redesign 2026-08-11). Poker-card sized (750×1050), ONE per player, DOUBLE-SIDED: FRONT lists the six turn actions (labels only — the full explanation lives in the rulebook); BACK gives that character's ability + flaw in brief. Rendered by build_board.py --type aidcard (front once + one back per characters.csv row, tinted in the character's colour). This REPLACES the old verbose single-sheet aid — the follower lifecycle / market-discard / SINK detail it used to backfill now lives ONLY in the rulebook, per the CD steer 'save explanation for the rulebook'. Backs are keyed by characters.csv id; display fields (English name, 漢字, Tâi-lô, colour) are pulled from characters.csv at render time so this file never drifts from the roster.
title: YOUR TURN
turn_rule: Take ONE action. Then trim your Larder down to 7.

actions.name: MARKET RUN
actions.brief: Reveal 3 from this market — keep 2. Events fire.

actions.name: CONVENIENCE STORE
actions.brief: Reveal 1 from any market — take it, or its event fires.

actions.name: TRAVEL
actions.brief: Hop 1 region (HSR 北↔南) and grow 1 follower — no ingredient.

actions.name: PROMOTE
actions.brief: Send up to 2 followers from your board onto stalls.

actions.name: SIGN UP
actions.brief: Biggest crowd + crowd-floor wins it; pay its recipe, less your discounts.

actions.name: BOOK A TOUR
actions.brief: Take 1 Booking from the row into your hand.

footer: Your agent bends these rules — flip for your ability & flaw.

C1.ability: At home, start each turn by drawing 1 ingredient from any market — free, no action.
C1.flaw: Leave your home region and the favours dry up.

C2.ability: On a Travel, draw the top 2 of the region you just left — and keep both.

C3.ability: On a Market Run, keep all 3 you reveal — not 2.
C3.flaw: Hazards bite TWICE on your Market Run.

C4.ability: You command 8 followers; everyone else gets 6.
C4.flaw: You take the LAST seat every round.

C5.ability: You win a contested stall on a tie — a rival needs the bigger crowd to beat you.
C5.flaw: None. It's good to be the Boss.

C6.ability: Your Travel reaches ANY region in one go, and shrugs off HSR outages.
C6.flaw: Every long hop tires 1 follower back to your supply.
